title: alangium villosum subsp. vitiense
intro: Alangium villosum subsp. vitiense, commonly known as Fiji alangium, is a plant species within the Alangiaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Fiji alangium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and fever, as well as treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Alangium villosum subsp. vitiense include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
